reading.body:
CyrusOne Somerset (NYM1) publishes 23 MW of IT capacity, making it the second-largest disclosed data center in New Jersey and 20.7 percent of the state's published total.

Only five of 48 mapped data centers in New Jersey publish power figures, and those five total 111.3 MW. Somerset's 23 MW is therefore a large share of what is publicly known, but most facilities in the state do not disclose capacity, so the published total undercounts actual inventory. At 40 kW per rack, the facility could hold roughly 575 racks, and at 80 kW per rack, roughly 290 racks.

For AI, 23 MW is modest relative to hyperscale training clusters. The campus publishes no certifications and no tenant base or power consumption profile, so its actual AI workload cannot be determined. Its location near the New York metro market and the northern New Jersey grid may make it relevant to distributed inference or smaller training jobs, but that relevance is not established by the published data.
